title: Let patience gather real wealth
summary: In holy company, wandering stops and patience ripens into Naam-rich honor. Wait by listening instead of simmering.
takeaway: Wait by listening instead of simmering.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts running toward quicker returns, slow the breath and stay with the quieter work. Let patience make the account, not impulse.

source.shortMeaning: In holy company, wandering stops and patience ripens into Naam-rich honor.
source.lifeApplication: When hurry rises, stay with the practice that grows wealth you can actually keep.
